description: Steam workshop configuration of a gameserver whose game supports it (e.g. Garry's Mod, ARK, DayZ, Project Zomboid): item ids with titles and validation, the collection id, disabled items and whether changes wait for the next start. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_gameserver_workshop
title: Get Game Server Steam Workshop
